description: Sign out: revoke the API token this principal signed in with, through a device sign-in (thalovant_poll_device_login) or a browser sign-in (thalovant_poll_browser_login), and stop using it. A token may always revoke itself, and one already revoked counts as revoked; signing out again answers alreadyRevoked without a request. Tokens configured on the server are never touched.
name: thalovant_revoke_device_login
title: Revoke Device Sign-In
